stage.name: Firegold Cavern
stage.description:
<Catch Zone> Deployed Operators can catch weakened Originium slugs within their attack range.
The caverns here resemble the Forbidden Tsalimashtu, but even the scorching magma fails to deter slug hunting adventurers.
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.name: Infused Originium Slug
infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen, exploding upon death. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units

blazing_originium_slug.name: Blazing Originium Slug
blazing_originium_slug.flavourText: A wild infected creature, they spray superheated fluids at their foes, posing more of a threat than typical Originium Slugs. Abundant in environments with abnormal energy, their breeding and migration patterns remain a mystery.

pyric_originium_slug.name: Pyric Originium Slug
pyric_originium_slug.flavourText: A wild infected creature, the final stages of infection having led them to burn even hotter. Their fluids, hot as magma, melt even their own bodies. Once cooled, beautiful patterns can be found in the pools they leave behind.

volatile_originium_slug.name: Volatile Originium Slug
volatile_originium_slug.flavourText: The name of this Originium Slug may actually be a misnomer, as the volatile part is actually the 'harvest' between its legs. When asked about this, its namers claimed that these creatures were too fast to be closely observed.
abilities: Cannot be blocked by Operators or Summons; explodes when Blocked and deals great AoE damage

infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.name: Infused Originium Slug α
infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen, exploding upon death. More dangerous than a normal Infused Originium Slug. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units

elite_wasteland_robber.name: Elite Wasteland Robber
elite_wasteland_robber.flavourText: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands using stolen weapons. Now leading a small group of subordinates, they have kept their plundering habits and are even greedier than their henchmen.
abilities: Steals 1 DP from allied Operators after several attacks

flying_originium_slug.name: Flying Originium Slug
flying_originium_slug.flavourText: Wild and infected, it can glide a short distance on the wind with its small wings, enough to fly over obstacles and evade capture.

elite_wasteland_plunderer.name: Elite Wasteland Plunderer
elite_wasteland_plunderer.flavourText: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands, equipped with the best gear the bandits can get their hands on. The most vicious plunderers are completely indifferent to the suffering of others, having long forgotten that they were once just the most desperate of civilians.
abilities: After several attacks, steals 3 DP and recovers a certain amount of HP

elite_wasteland_skulker.name: Elite Wasteland Skulker
elite_wasteland_skulker.flavourText: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands, sneakily operating in the shadows. Some claim to have complicated pasts, but the truth of it is irrelevant: their skillsets are now used only for survival.
abilities: When on the field, natural DP regeneration rate is reduced

bounty_hunter_crossbowman.name: Bounty Hunter Crossbowman
bounty_hunter_crossbowman.flavourText: A bounty hunter adept at attacking from long-range. A little skilled, but nothing more. Moonlights as a bandit when there is no bounty to hunt.
abilities: After several attacks, the next attack deals splash damage to a cross area surrounding the target and steals DP equivalent to the number of targets hit

bounty_hunter_crossbowman_captain.name: Bounty Hunter Crossbowman Captain
bounty_hunter_crossbowman_captain.flavourText: A bounty hunter adept at attacking from long-range. A little skilled, with some notoriety. New bounties don't show up every day, so why not earn some extra money in their free time?
abilities: After several attacks, the next attack deals splash damage to a cross area surrounding the target and steals DP equivalent to the number of targets hit

pompeii.name: 'Pompeii'
pompeii.flavourText: A massive infected beast. These aberrations were born in a special high-temperature environment. Nobody wants to approach these creatures due to their grotesque appearance and the extreme heat they give off. The existence of these giant creatures has been known since ancient times, but to see one warped by infection is terrifyingly unforgettable...
abilities: Can attack up to 4 targets at once and ignites targets it attacks, dealing Immolation damage over time
Self-immolates when blocked, dealing heavy damage
Gains significantly increased ASPD when HP drops to half
